answer: Latency-Weighted Attention Ledger. Each identity accrues voting weight only from verified, interval-spaced task completions that a vine of prior participants must countersign; weight decays unless the identity keeps returning real-time answers whose timing matches a cipher of its own past response patterns. Enforcement: a fresh sybil farm can buy throughput but not history, since forged countersignatures fail the timing cipher and clusters collapse to near-zero weight. Attacker cost per identity: sustained attention across many cycles plus a crystal of captured timing history,
